review_candidates.title: Finance Business Partner
review_candidates.description: Position Title: Finance Business Partner (Indonesia & Thailand) Location: Jakarta, Indonesia Business Scope: Overseas power plant investment and development, with a focus on renewable energy and infrastructure projects across Southeast Asia. Position Summary We are seeking a commercially minded Finance Business Partner to support our power plant investment and development business in Indonesia and Thailand . Based in Indonesia , this role will work closely with the regional business, investment, and project teams to provide financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, performance monitoring, and decision support across project development and operational activities. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of relevant finance experience , preferably in renewable energy, power, infrastructure, project development, or investment-related industries . Candidates with Mandarin Chinese proficiency will be highly preferred due to cross-border communication needs. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Partnering & Financial Support Act as the finance business partner to the business teams in Indonesia and Thailand , supporting day-to-day financial and commercial decision-making. Work closely with development, investment, and functional teams to evaluate business initiatives, project costs, and operational performance. Provide financial insights and recommendations to improve profitability, cost efficiency, and resource allocation. 2. Budgeting, Forecasting & Reporting Lead and coordinate the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and monthly rolling forecast processes for the Indonesia and Thailand businesses. Monitor actual performance against budget/forecast and analyze key variances. Prepare regular management reports, including business performance reviews, budget tracking, cash flow updates, and financial commentary. 3. Project & Investment Financial Analysis Support project-level financial analysis for power and renewable energy development projects, including CAPEX/OPEX tracking, profitability analysis, and investment return review. Assist in evaluating project economics, financial assumptions, and business cases for new development and investment opportunities. Work with internal stakeholders to ensure financial discipline throughout the project lifecycle. 4. Cost Control & Performance Monitoring Track project development spending and operating expenses to ensure alignment with approved budgets. Identify financial risks, cost overruns, and opportunities for optimization. Support the implementation of financial controls, performance KPIs, and process improvements across the business. 5. Cross-functional Coordination Liaise with local business teams, regional finance, headquarters, and external advisors where necessary. Support ad hoc financial analysis, management presentations, and strategic planning exercises. Facilitate communication between local teams and Chinese-speaking stakeholders when required. Requirements Experience Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration , or a related field. 3–5 years of relevant work experience in: Finance Business Partnering FP&A Corporate Finance Project Finance support Commercial Finance Prior experience in renewable energy, power, utilities, infrastructure, EPC, project development, or investment-related sectors is highly preferred. Technical Skills Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting skills. Good understanding of financial statements, cost control, and business performance analysis. Experience in project-based or multi-country business environments is a plus. Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint ; familiarity with financial systems/ERP tools is an advantage. Language Skills English proficiency is required. Mandarin Chinese is highly preferred. Bahasa Indonesia and/or Thai language ability would be a plus. Personal Attributes Strong business partnering mindset with the ability to work closely with non-finance teams. Good communication and stakeholder management skills in a multicultural environment. Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of handling multiple priorities. Willingness to be based in Indonesia and support regional business needs across Indonesia and Thailand . Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting cross-border or regional finance operations. Exposure to project development, investment analysis, or infrastructure-related business models. Familiarity with the financial dynamics of renewable energy or power projects.

review_candidates.title: Cost Manager (Construction) - Norway / Sweden / Finland (Hybrid)
review_candidates.description: Are you a Cost / Commercial Manager that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? Do you crave the freedom, power, and support to bring fresh ideas to how work is delivered, so client expectations are not just met, but smashed? Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is quite real! Read on! _____________________________________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects! If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. ) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself Care about people – your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _____________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role Supercharge client service: Deliver cutting-edge cost management powered by digital tools, moving beyond static reporting to dynamic project insight. Cradle-to-grave expertise: Oversee every commercial aspect of projects, from initial concepts through close-out. Champion collaboration: Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, particularly with project managers, planners and design teams, to ensure timely, on-budget, and high-quality project deliver. Innovate fearlessly: Bring fresh ideas to the table, design new processes, and exceed industry expectations with progressive thinking. Embrace digital transformation: Lead the integration of project management elements through Laminar's project controls-centric delivery, streamlining workflow and maximising control. Think outside spreadsheets: We aren't looking for Excel-only users. We want professionals who embrace a digitally enhanced approach to cost management. Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on: Understanding what the real problems of projects are. Implementing the best solutions to those problems. Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology. More specifically you will be part of our Commercial Services Team. Your leader will be our Commercial Director. Your top three objectives: To make construction projects deliver to near perfection To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems To develop yourself and everyone around you Own the cost : Manage the project costs through all stage gates, integrating QCRA and risk-adjusted forecasting to provide a "no surprises" financial environment. Own the outcome : Lead pre-construction estimating and post-contract live cost management. This includes managing complex change orders with deep-dive cost analysis to protect the client’s interests. Report and inform : Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively (Laminar’s existing infrastructure will support this). Make scalable solutions : Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved Develop everyone : Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well. Your capabilities: You will be a seasoned Cost / Commercial Manager, with extensive experience working directly with clients, ideally with some stints working for Tier 1 or 2 Contractors as well, to provide the well-rounded experience that is hugely valuable as a consultant. You understand that cost does not live in a vacuum - it is a byproduct of schedule, risk, and scope. You must have: Mastery : Cost Management background with at least 10+ years of experience on construction projects Communication: Proficient in written and spoken English communication skills. Additional language abilities are appreciated, with Norwegian considered an advantage. Leadership : A relentless approach to dealing with people Impact : A track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics Location: Experience working within the Nordic market and willingness to travel every other week to support our regional operations. Data Centre Focus (Desirable): Prior experience in Data Centres or high-tech industrial projects is highly valued. Proven ability to develop comprehensive commercial strategies for complex construction projects, encompassing budgeting, forecasting, risk management, and cost control, from initiation to close-out and handover. Demonstrated success in leading negotiations with clients, contractors, and stakeholders to secure optimal terms and favourable outcomes in fast-paced environments. Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team _____________________________________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. _____________________________________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment The life-changing stuff: In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up _____________________________________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: Why you want to join us What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Systems Integration Engineer
review_candidates.description: ALTEN is a global engineering and technology consultancy operating across over 35 countries worldwide. We partner with industry leaders across sectors including Aeronautics, Aerospace, Defence, Naval, Automotive, Energy, Rail, IT and many more to deliver innovative engineering solutions that drive technological advancement & support sustainable transformation. Our teams of passionate and agile engineers work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of technology and sustainability. At ALTEN, we empower talented engineers to innovate, solve complex challenges, and deliver impactful solutions that build tomorrow’s world—today. Join us and start building tomorrow’s world today! Job Description We are looking for an experienced Systems Integration Engineer to join a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for the integration, validation, and delivery of complex gas turbine engine systems. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring effective integration across multiple engine subsystems, working closely with design, systems, controls, electronics, testing, and certification teams. This position is ideal for an engineer with a strong understanding of gas turbine engines and the interactions between mechanical, electrical, and control system interfaces. Location: Derby On Site: Hybrid (3x onsite) Clearance: Clearable Experience Level: Mid Level Key Responsibilities: Lead and support systems integration activities across complex propulsion systems. Ensure effective integration and compatibility between engine subsystems and associated equipment. Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve technical integration challenges. Assess and manage system interfaces, requirements, dependencies, and interactions throughout the product lifecycle. Support system architecture development and integration planning activities. Review and validate engineering solutions to ensure compliance with programme and customer requirements. Support verification and validation activities, including analysis, testing, and issue resolution. Investigate and resolve integration issues through root cause analysis and corrective actions. Contribute to technical reviews, design assessments, and stakeholder meetings. Ensure engineering activities are delivered in accordance with programme schedules, quality requirements, and industry best practices. Qualifications Required Skills: I ndustry experience in systems engineering, systems integration, or a related engineering function. Experience working with gas turbine engines or complex propulsion systems. Strong understanding of system integration principles and the interactions between multiple engineering disciplines and subsystems. Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and control systems and their integration within complex engineered products. Experience managing technical interfaces, requirements, and system dependencies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical issues. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership and drive technical solutions. Enthusiastic learner with the ability to adapt within a fast-paced engineering environment. Required Qualifications: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering , or equivalent military experience . Desirable Skills: Knowledge of engine electrical hardware and associated interfaces. Experience within the aerospace, defence, energy, or other highly regulated engineering sectors. Familiarity with systems engineering methodologies and requirements management tools. Experience supporting verification, validation, and testing activities. Understanding of engine control systems and integration processes. Knowledge of product development lifecycles within complex engineering programmes. Additional Information Why join us? We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies. At ALTEN, you’ll work on exciting projects, supported by ongoing learning, mentoring, and clear career development tailored to your goals. Join a passionate team and help build tomorrow, today. In short you get: A personalised career path and a rewarding management style A huge diversity of engineering projects and industries Private Medical Insurance Cycle & Tech Scheme Employee assistance programme Life insurance & Pension Scheme Social atmosphere, regular gatherings & team buildings Flexible way of working (role dependent) We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant & actively encourage applications from members of the Armed Forces community, including veterans, reservists, service leavers, and military spouses/partners. We recognise the value of military skills and experience and are committed to ensuring that no applicant is unfairly disadvantaged during our recruitment and selection processes. ALTEN is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and values the strength that comes from a global mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of background or protected characteristics under the Equality Act 2010. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. This role may require you to have or be willing to go through Security Clearance. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard; details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website Gov.UK. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected . Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

review_candidates.title: Health Economics Analyst (HTA)
review_candidates.description: MAHTA Sp. z o. o. jest firmą, której zakres działalności łączy obszar Market-Access (MA) i oceny technologii medycznych – Health Technology Assessment (HTA). Zespół analityków firmy MAHTA to ludzie doświadczeni, ciekawi świata, kreatywni i stale podnoszący swoje kompetencje. Jesteśmy dumni, że finalnym efektem naszej pracy jest zwiększanie chorym dostępu do skutecznego leczenia. Rozwijamy zespół, dlatego poszukujemy osób na stanowisko: Health Economics Analyst (HTA) .    To stanowisko dla osoby, która lubi pracować z liczbami, Excelem i modelami analitycznymi i chce wykorzystać te umiejętności w ochronie zdrowia. Nie wymagamy wcześniejszego doświadczenia w HTA — nauczymy Cię tego obszaru. Oczekujemy natomiast bardzo dobrych zdolności ilościowych, sprawnego Excela i swobodnej pracy z danymi. Praca wykonywana zdalnie na terenie Polski lub stacjonarnie/hybrydowo w Warszawie.   Aplikuj Jeżeli interesuje Cię praca łącząca analizę danych, modelowanie ekonomiczne oraz realny wpływ na dostęp pacjentów do skutecznego leczenia, prześlij CV na adres: rekrutacja@mahta.pl W temacie wiadomości koniecznie wpisz: „Dział ekonomiczny”. Na zgłoszenia czekamy do 30 września 2026 r. Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi Kandydatami, których profile najlepiej odpowiadają aktualnym potrzebom rekrutacyjnym. Twoja rola Dołączysz do zespołu projektowego pracującego pod opieką lidera projektu. Będziesz uczestniczyć w przygotowywaniu analiz ekonomicznych oraz analiz wpływu na budżet, wykorzystywanych w procesach refundacyjnych leków w Polsce. Niezależnie od Twojego dotychczasowego doświadczenia zapewnimy Ci kompleksowe wdrożenie i przygotujemy Cię do pracy zgodnie ze standardami MAHTA. Zakres obowiązków przygotowywanie analiz ekonomicznych ( cost-effectiveness , cost-utility , cost-minimization ) oraz analiz wpływu na budżet (BIA) w ramach raportów HTA; opracowywanie modeli ekonomicznych i budżetowych z wykorzystaniem powszechnych narzędzi analitycznych; pozyskiwanie, porządkowanie oraz analiza danych klinicznych, epidemiologicznych, kosztowych i statystycznych; przygotowywanie prognoz oraz analiz ilościowych wykorzystywanych w procesach refundacyjnych; udział w opracowywaniu założeń modelowych oraz interpretacji wyników analiz; współpraca przy rozwijaniu nowych narzędzi analitycznych oraz usprawnianiu procesów modelowania ekonomicznego. Wymagania Niezbędne wykształcenie wyższe (lub w trakcie studiów) na kierunku takim jak ekonomia, matematyka, statystyka, ekonometria, metody ilościowe, analiza danych, zdrowie publiczne, farmakoekonomia lub innym kierunku pokrewnym; wysoko rozwinięte zdolności analityczne i umiejętność wyciągania wniosków z danych; bardzo dobra praktyczna znajomość Excel: złożone formuły, funkcje wyszukiwania, tabele przestawne, analiza danych i budowa modeli; znajomość statystyki i metod ilościowych; znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną pracę z publikacjami naukowymi i dokumentacją techniczną; skrupulatność, systematyczność i dbałość o szczegóły; gotowość do szybkiego uczenia się; umiejętność pracy zespołowej i jasnego komunikowania się. Mile widziane doświadczenie w obszarze HTA, ekonomiki zdrowia, analizy danych lub modelowania ekonomicznego; praktyczna znajomość VBA, Python, R lub innych narzędzi analitycznych; wcześniejsze doświadczenie w tworzeniu modeli analitycznych lub pracy z dużymi zbiorami danych. Oferujemy kompleksowe wdrożenie do pracy w obszarze HTA oraz wsparcie doświadczonego zespołu; udział w projektach, których efektem jest wspieranie dostępu pacjentów do nowoczesnych terapii; możliwość zdobywania specjalistycznej wiedzy z zakresu HTA, ekonomiki zdrowia i procesów refundacyjnych; szeroki zakres szkoleń oraz kurs języka angielskiego; możliwość pracy zdalnej i elastyczne godziny pracy; otwartą, przyjazną atmosferę oraz pracę w zespole nastawionym na współpracę i dzielenie się wiedzą; prywatną opiekę medyczną i kartę MultiSport; spotkania oraz wyjazdy integracyjne. Informacje dotyczące danych osobowych Prosimy o zamieszczenie w CV następującej klauzuli: „Wyrażam zgodę na przetwarzanie moich danych osobowych zawartych w niniejszym dokumencie do realizacji procesu rekrutacji zgodnie z ustawą z dnia 10 maja 2018 roku o ochronie danych osobowych (Dz.U. z 2018 r. poz. 1000) oraz zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. (RODO)”. Szczegółowe informacje dotyczące przetwarzania danych osobowych znajdują się na stronie: Polityka prywatności MAHTA

review_candidates.description: About Axis We believe financial services should be more accessible, that’s why we started Axis. A fully interoperable mobile wallet which enables users to send and receive money from any mobile wallet in Egypt, pay their bills, buy anything online with a virtual Visa card, or scan any QR code to pay for anything in-person. Axis empowers small businesses with simplified digital payments to compete & grow. Our digital banking platform enables small businesses to seamlessly manage payments to employees and suppliers. Small businesses can now send salaries, reimbursements and instantly pay their suppliers on any mobile wallet in Egypt. Overview Of The Role We’re looking for a sharp, experienced Backend Developer, ideally with strong proficiency in Go, Node, or Java to help us build robust and scalable backend services powering our fintech applications. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance backend services for our fintech applications. Implement scalable and reliable microservices following established architectural standards and engineering practices. Work with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and contribute to well-defined domain and service boundaries. Develop and integrate event-driven services and asynchronous processing workflows. Work with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal to implement reliable business processes and long-running workflows. Design and implement well-structured RESTful APIs and service-to-service integrations. Collaborate with Product, Frontend, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality features. Investigate, debug, and resolve issues across distributed services and production environments. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following established coding and security standards. Develop and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure application quality and reliability. Contribute to code reviews and continuously improve code quality and engineering practices. Monitor application health and help identify performance, reliability, and scalability issues. Maintain appropriate technical documentation for services, APIs, and system behavior. Participate in Agile development practices including planning, refinement, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives. Skills & Qualifications 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development experience. Proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Experience with backend frameworks such as Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, or NestJS. Good understanding of microservices architecture and distributed application concepts. Practical understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts. Experience working with event-driven architectures and asynchronous communication. Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases and a good understanding of data modeling. Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles. Experience writing unit and integration tests. Hands-on experience with debugging and troubleshooting backend applications. Basic understanding of application monitoring, logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. Familiarity with Agile methodologies and collaborative software development practices. Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals, clean code, SOLID principles, and common design patterns. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Nice to Have Experience with Temporal or other workflow orchestration platforms. Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD practices. Experience working in fintech, payments, banking, or other high-availability systems. Familiarity with distributed systems concepts such as idempotency, retries, eventual consistency, and fault tolerance.
